accounting_description: The books of the business: chart of accounts, entries, periods and filings.
accounting_inactive_title: You do not keep books here yet
accounting_inactive_body: Activating accounting seeds the chart of accounts and starts recording an entry for every sale, purchase, cash movement and close. Anything before the date you pick is not reconstructed.
accounting_start_date_hint: Sales before this date do not enter the books: they have no frozen cost, and rebuilding them would be inventing data.
accounting_opening_hint: What was there before you started, taken from your previous balance sheet. Debits and credits must add up to the same. You can leave it blank and enter it later with a manual entry.
accounting_activated: Accounting activated. {accounts} accounts and {mappings} mapping rows were seeded.
accounting_unclassified_hint: These are movements the system could not assign to an account. Resolve them from the entry, naming the account they belong to.
accounting_delete_account_confirm: Delete account {code}? Only possible if it never had movements.
accounting_system_hint: System accounts are needed by the mapping: they can be renamed, not deleted or deactivated.
accounting_mapping_hint: Anything without an account falls into Unclassified and shows in red. The entry is written anyway: a sale is never stopped for this.
accounting_mapping_saved: Mapping saved. It affects what comes next, not what is already in the books.
accounting_entry_balance_hint: Debits and credits must add up to the same. An entry that does not balance is not saved.
accounting_entry_empty: No entries in this period yet.
accounting_reclassify_hint: An adjusting entry dated today is written, referencing this one. The original is not touched.
accounting_reclassified: Done. The balance is in its account.
accounting_close_confirm: Close {period}? After closing, nothing can be written with a date in that month, and it cannot be reopened. Anything to correct is done with an adjusting entry in the open period.
accounting_periods_empty: No periods yet. The first one is born with the first entry.
accounting_report_balanced: Balances: {debits} in debits and the same in credits.
accounting_report_not_balanced: Does not balance: {debits} in debits against {credits} in credits.
accounting_equation_broken: The balance sheet does not add up. Tell support: something was written without going through the system.
accounting_vat_description: The tax for the month: what was charged against what was paid. It is a draft to fill the filing, not the filing.
accounting_vat_empty: There were no sales or purchases in this period.
accounting_vat_net_hint: Output tax is net of returns.
